name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Agree on the direction. Google spreading custom silicon across vendors fits what we've seen, and Broadcom's scale and track record with Google still count for a lot. v10 is a long way out though, so Dec 9 earnings will tell us more about the mix.
周五那波 -12.2% 之后，两边到现在还没达成共识：期权那边还是防御姿态，看跌溢价 $343M，看涨 $195.6M；另一边抄底的声量一点没减，观察名单里 AVGO 直接排第一。感恩节这周量又淡，波动估计小不了。$AVGO

This is the other side of Friday's selloff. Every hyperscaler said the same thing in Q3, demand still ahead of supply, and FY2027 CapEx plans haven't moved. A mix shift at one customer isn't the whole budget shrinking. $AVGO

€86M in cash deposits against ~$1.2B of reservations is the part that stands out. That is committed demand, not a forecast, and with CPO starting in CY27 the co-packaged switch sits right at the center of it.
砍单砍的是 TPU，机架里的交换芯片不在此列。AInvest 的看法是，Google 削减的是定制 XPU 那端，博通的以太网组网（Tomahawk Ultra 这类）没在削减范围里。Hock Tan 说组网长期占 AI 收入 30–40%，Q3 只有 27%。周五 AVGO 跌了 12.2%，组网这块到底有没有被错杀，12/9 财报见分晓。$AVGO

The middle tier is where $AVGO sits at ~160bps. Not the stressed end of the chart, but financing commitments keep growing, and Friday's -12.2% close shows how quickly the market reprices that risk. Credit is becoming part of the AI story.

The five-year shortage call stands out. For Broadcom, packaging, power and cooling as the binding constraints cuts both ways: it supports demand for custom silicon and networking, but it also limits how quickly that demand becomes shipments.
郭明錤称 Google 把 2027 年 TPU 8i 砍掉约 100 万颗，占那系列出货的 20%，砍的还是单价最高的 8i Max。AVGO 周五跌 12.2% 收 304.41，AI 股集体抛售，这消息让它跑输板块。数字来自一家产业调查，Google 和博通都没表态，先当传闻看。验证看 12/9 财报 FY27 AI 收入指引 $115B 保不保得住。$AVGO

That CoWoS-L line is the key part for AVGO. It closed at $346.65 yesterday, just above its 50-day at $343.86. Still only supply-chain chatter, so worth watching rather than assuming the shift is done.
Same pattern in $AVGO yesterday: up to $369.26 intraday, then faded to close at $346.65, down 2.1%. Every bounce is getting sold for now. The basing part is the hard part to wait for.

Worth taking seriously: admin access with no credentials, no workaround, and exploited since September. Patches are out, so the question is how fast customers move. VMware is a big part of the software side of $AVGO, not just the AI chip story.
AVGO at -28% sits mid-pack here, same as TSMC. The striking thing is how uniform the list is. This is a tape-wide de-rating, not a Broadcom story.
有测算认为 2028 年 GPU 和 ASIC 支出要到 1 万亿美元、增 46%，但大厂资本开支共识比这低 5–15%。账对不上，估值锚就得重算。AVGO 昨天盘中到过 369.26，收盘 346.65 跌 2.1%，大概就是这种分歧。 $AVGO
